verdict.rationale: Decagon is an AI customer-support platform, so an official CLI is a fair question for this kind of product and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a CLI. The docs stress natural-language AOPs, Duet, and integrations that need no custom code, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
